entry.title: Porchlamp snapshot 2026-10-24: 11,000 open-source projects measured
entry.summary: We followed 1,442,863 pull requests from 227,260 outside contributors to 11,000 GitHub projects, from 25 April to 22 October 2026. 2,765 ranked, 5,506 gated and 2,729 unrated.

entry.title: Stars don't review pull requests: the state of open-source black holes
entry.summary: More than 1 in 5. In Porchlamp's 2026-10-24 snapshot, 845 of 4,125 active open-source projects (20.5%) left most outside pull requests with no human reply, review or merge within 14 days. More stars, more silence. The share rises with stars: 17% of projects with 1,000 to 10,000 stars, 24% at 10,000 to 50,000, and 27% at 50,000 or more.
